messages.snippet: Are you around for lunch on Friday? A few of us are going to the Vietnamese place near Liverpool Str
messages.subject: Lunch Friday?
messages.plaintextBody:
Are you around for lunch on Friday? A few of us are going to the Vietnamese place near Liverpool Street around 1. No work talk allowed. Let me know!
E
